hints.hint: Salvaged from ascended weapons and armor with an Ascended Salvage Kit (guaranteed) or ascended trinkets/back items (low chance). Account bound; not tradable.

Received for completing map exploration of Tangled Depths. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.

Obtained from the Gift of Battle Item Reward Track (WvW). Formerly purchasable from Battle Master for 500 Badges of Honor; that vendor path was removed in the Spring 2016 Quarterly Update. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.
Made at a Place of Power from 25 Quartz Crystals. Limited to 1 per day per account; account bound, not tradable.
Purchased from Castaway Agnes in Hullgarden. Paid for in account-bound items, so this module cannot price it and counts it as 0. Not craftable; no recipe.
Purchased from Canach in Breezy Cay. Paid for in account-bound items, so this module cannot price it and counts it as 0. Not craftable; no recipe.

Awarded for completing the Radiance of the Sun God achievement; further copies from Palak in Hullgarden. That purchase is part barter, so this module cannot price it and counts it as 0. Not craftable; no recipe.

Rewarded by open-world content: gathering nodes, world boss chests (3-30 ore), and reward-track loot boxes such as the WvW Hero Weapon Box, which gives 50. No vendor sells it; the wiki's only seller was the Battle Historian, removed in the June 2017 Competitive Feature Pack. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.

Awarded by chests rather than vendors: any open-world, jumping puzzle or mini-dungeon chest gives 2-9 (level 80 in most cases), dungeon explorable paths give 20 for each of the first two completions per day, and Cracked Fractal Encryptions 15 or 50. No vendor sells it; the wiki's only seller was the Battle Historian, removed in the June 2017 Competitive Feature Pack. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.

No longer obtainable: the wiki marks the item discontinued, and its only seller was the Battle Historian, removed in the June 2017 Competitive Feature Pack. Copies already held still upgrade Hero's weapons to Mistforged Hero's weapons in the Mystic Forge. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.

Chosen from the Hero Weapon Box, the final reward of the WvW Hero Weapon Reward Track, or from a WvW Exclusives Choice Chest. The skirmish merchants stock most Hero's weapons but not this one; its only wiki vendor was the Battle Historian, removed in the June 2017 Competitive Feature Pack. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.

Chosen from the Hero Weapon Box, the final reward of the WvW Hero Weapon Reward Track, or from a WvW Exclusives Choice Chest. The skirmish merchants stock most Hero's weapons but not this one; its only wiki vendor was the Battle Historian, removed in the June 2017 Competitive Feature Pack. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.

No longer obtainable: the July 19, 2022 game update replaced Legendary Divinations with Legendary Insights, and the retired Path of Fire raid vendor page is the only place the wiki records them being sold. Double-click one you already hold to exchange it for a Legendary Insight. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.

No longer obtainable: the July 19, 2022 game update retired the Path of Fire raid Gaeting Crystal, exchanged every one held for an equal number of Magnetite Shards, and switched the merchants that took it over to Magnetite Shards. The wallet currency of the same name earned in Janthir Wilds raids is a different one. Account bound; not tradable; no recipe.
